svg.title: 488 Wang tiles: exact seeded-half-plane tile inventory
svg.desc: All 488 distinct oriented Wang tile types from the pinned K215 diagonal construction, each shown once. Four triangular faces encode the north, east, south and west edge colors. Edge codes disambiguate every color. Seed tile 487 is enlarged and outlined in gold. The catalog is not a tiling; this is not an unrestricted whole-plane result.
